subject: Demo — request to reschedule pending procurement/security gating
messages:
From: Jenny Park <jenny.park@acmehealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo next week — NDA + vendor onboarding

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the invite. We're excited to see Redwood's dedicated inference offering and how it could help our models in production. A quick heads-up from our side: Procurement and IT security require a completed NDA and vendor onboarding checklist before we allow vendor demos that include architecture/network deepdives.

I've looped in procurement (cc) and IT security so they can indicate any additional needs. Can you send over a standard NDA and the onboarding checklist? Also, we have a travel week Oct 6–8 for our data science team, so if procurement needs time, we might need to push the demo out until the following week.

Best,
Jenny
Jenny Park
Director of Data Science | Acme Health

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jenny Park <jenny.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-10-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo next week — NDA + vendor onboarding

Hi Jenny — thanks for the heads up and for looping procurement and IT security in.

Attaching our standard mutual NDA and a vendor onboarding checklist to this thread (see attachments). Marissa (SE) and Rishi (security) are on copy — Marissa will run the demo and can tailor the agenda to focus more on the non-sensitive parts if you want to run a higher-level session before paperwork is finished. Rishi can answer any security-specific questions procurement raises.

If procurement needs to review the questionnaire, we can hold the demo until the team is ready. Tentative availability for Marissa and our engineering lead is:
- Tue Oct 13: 11:00–12:00 PT
- Wed Oct 14: 09:00–10:00 PT
- Thu Oct 15: 14:00–15:00 PT

If those don't work, tell us your preferred windows and we'll align. Also happy to do a short 30-min intro next week that avoids infra/network details while paperwork is finalized.

Attachments: NDA_template.pdf (attached), Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (attached)

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jenny Park <jenny.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: itsec@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-10-02T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo next week — NDA + vendor onboarding

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the attachments. A few items from procurement/security:\
1) We need the NDA returned signed by both parties. Please confirm who at Redwood will sign and provide the name and title for our record.
2) Our security team has sent over a short vendor questionnaire — it covers hosting, encryption, SIEM, and incident response. Can Redwood complete it and return by EOD Friday (Oct 2)? If not, we'll need an extra week to review and route approvals internally.
3) We also need the vendor SOC 2 report or a statement about SOC 2 compliance status.

I've attached the vendor questionnaire in case you didn't receive it. Once we have the questionnaire and signed NDA, we can confirm the demo window.

Regards,
Alex Ramos
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Health
Attachment: Acme_Security_Questionnaire.docx

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo next week — NDA + vendor onboarding

Hi Alex and team — looping in security details and proposed timeline.

Quick answers:\
- Signing: I (Rishi Malhotra, Head of Security) will sign the NDA on behalf of Redwood. Title: Head of Security.
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in-scope; I attached a SOC 2 cover note and a link to our compliance portal in the drive link below for your reviewers.
- Questionnaire: We'll complete the vendor questionnaire. Marissa and I will split the sections; we expect to return the completed doc by COB Friday Oct 2. If you require third-party attestation docs, let's surface them now.

If the questionnaire review takes longer, we understand the need to push the demo. Proposed fallback: quick 30-min exec intro on Oct 7 or 8 (sync call, no infra) and then full technical demo the week of Oct 13 once paperwork is done.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-onboarding

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOC2_cover_note.pdf

From: Jenny Park <jenny.park@acmehealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, itsec@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-10-05T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood demo next week — NDA + vendor onboarding

Thanks all — quick update from our side. Procurement and IT reviewed your materials; the questionnaire looks good but we need the fully signed NDA returned (Procurement wants the signed PDF). We've routed this internally but our legal lead is traveling Oct 6–8 and won't approve until the 9th. Given that, let's move the full technical demo to the week of Oct 13. Can you lock in Wed Oct 14 09:00–10:00 PT? If so, we'll treat Oct 7 as a possible 30-min intro if your team is available that week.

Also, I'll upload the signed NDA to this thread as soon as legal completes it.

Appreciate the responsiveness — looking forward to it.

Best,
Jenny

---
Thread note: Jenny later uploaded Acme_NDA_signed.pdf to procurement systems; Redwood received copy via DocuSign link and confirmed signatures on Oct 9.
